description: Grade a domain's security posture A-F in one call, for vendor-risk or due-diligence checks. Runs the TLS, DNS (DNSSEC, CAA), registration-expiry, email-auth and HTTP-header checks and returns one letter, a 0-100 score, points per category (TLS 25, email 25, headers 20, DNS 15, registration 15) and the top fixes. Use it when you want a verdict; use site_health or the single checks when you need raw data. Unavailable categories are left out of the percentage (partial=true). Read-only; takes about 3-10 s. Costs $0.03 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.

domain.description: Hostname or URL, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com/path
